label: UKMTO: Critical
description: Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed — a conditional ceasefire holds but commercial transits sit at roughly 5% of the pre-conflict ~3,000 vessels/month. The US blockade of Iranian ports continues (CENTCOM reported 94 vessels turned away by 22 May 2026); rival US and Iranian forces control opposite ends, so transit needs clearance from both, and Iran's 'Persian Gulf Strait Authority' demands prior coordination. Operation Project Freedom escorts were paused 6 May pending Pakistan-mediated talks. Recent incidents (1-8 May) include a tanker struck by projectiles 78NM N of Fujairah, a bulk carrier attacked 11NM W of Sirik, and Iran's seizure of the tanker Ocean Koi in the Gulf of Oman. Red Sea / Gulf of Aden elevated — Houthis have signalled renewed attacks on Western-linked shipping; most carriers maintain Cape of Good Hope routing. Gulf of Aden / Somali Basin piracy threat sustained.
